body.message:
Ok If you would like to proceed with the reservation, kindly share the following details with us:

• Emirates ID or passport copy
• Email address
• Contact number

Once we receive the required details, we will share the payment link for the security deposit. Upon receipt of the payment, we will block the unit for you and proceed with confirming the reservation.

Please note that the unit will only be secured once the security deposit payment has been received.
